title: Works well enough, but thin and the zipper is light.
text: Works well enough, but thin and the zipper is light.. I don't expect to have this travel bag for that long. It's good enough to take to and from work, but not for heavy travel. There is no area for shoes or accessories, so keep that in mind. Great for short travels, however.
